Summen je Gefecht und Gegenfahrzeug. Unb.en: Totals per battle and opposing vehicle. Unknown values: –. The results do not provide ammunition types or incoming penetration/explosion counts. Explosion hits alone do not identify HE ammunition.

Nach Accountname, Alias oder Account-ID.en: Search by account name, alias or account ID. The account ID links encounters under different names.

Gesamtschaden, Schüsse, Treffer, Durchsc.en: Total damage, shots, hits, penetrations and assistance come from each player's final battle results. Missing values: –.

Ein Klick auf das Datum öffnet die Gefec.en: Click a date to open battle details or a player to select their account. Filters from other tabs do not apply here.

Lesezugriff · erste Anweisung pro Ausfüh.en: Read-only · first statement per execution · maximum 1,000 rows · 5-second limit. View filters do not apply here.

Fehlende Endergebnisse werden nicht als.en: Missing final results are not counted as losses or zero damage. Lists show them as pending.

Letzte Session: deine jüngste Folge von.en: Last session: your most recent series of random battles, separated by a break of more than 60 minutes. Changing tank or class does not change the session.

Grüne Winrate: mindestens 50 %. In der K.en: Green win rate: at least 50%. In the map matrix, colors are relative to your own class average within the current filters.

Assist = Aufklärung + Kette + Betäubung..en: Assistance = spotting + tracking + stun. Earnings show gross income, expenses and net income. Damage/received compares totals from battles where both values are known.

Credits netto = credits − autoRepairCost.en: Net credits = credits − autoRepairCost − autoLoadCost[0] − autoEquipCost[0]. Missing deductions remain unknown. Missions/events are included in gross income. Values excluding missions or reserves are adjusted comparisons, not additional profit.

Ausgaben sind die im Replay ausgewiesene.en: Expenses are the automatic deductions recorded in the replay. Purchases outside battle and historical stock costs are not fully covered. Gold and bonds are not converted to credits.

Verläufe zeigen Tageswerte, keine kumuli.en: History shows daily values rather than cumulative account statistics. Tank lists use the selected period.

Noch nicht enthalten: WN8, Dossier-/Erge.en: Not yet included: WN8, dossier/result-cache import, customizable widgets and 3D hit analysis. Battles left early may have no final result.

Spieldateien werden nicht verändert. Rep.en: Game files are not modified. Replay files are deleted only through Replay archive after full archival and explicit selection. No XVM and no runtime network requests.

Basisverdienst kann Fahrzeugfaktoren und.en: Base income may include vehicle factors and battle awards. Unexplained differences remain visible as other bonuses/adjustments.

Beim Import werden sämtliche JSON-Blöcke.en: Import preserves every JSON block, including unknown fields, and the complete binary stream in the separate archive database.

Das Archiv bewahrt alle Daten. Die Stati.en: The archive preserves all data. Statistics currently interpret only part of it. The binary stream is not yet fully decoded.

Dieses Replay enthält noch kein Endergeb.en: This replay has no final result yet. Battle-start information is available under Battle and participants.

Direkte Gegnertreffer gemäß WoT. Summen.en: Direct hits on opponents as recorded by WoT. Totals and averages include only final results with all three counters.

Dort sind Schaden, Verdienst, Erfahrung.en: Damage, earnings, experience and progress are grouped by topic. Participants and complete raw data have separate sections.

Grün: mindestens dein Klassenmittel im F.en: Green: at least your class average within the filter. Orange: below it. Statistical significance is not assessed.

Jeder Punkt ist ein Spieltag; Tage ohne.en: Each point represents a playing day; days without data are omitted. Hover over a point for its values.

Nation, Klasse, Tierstufe und Fahrzeugro.en: Select nation, class, tier and vehicle role

Noch kein Panzer erreicht die Mindestzah.en: No tank meets the minimum number of complete financial results. Lower the minimum or broaden the filters.

Trefferquote = Treffer / Schüsse. Durchs.en: Hit rate = hits / shots. Penetrations/hits and penetrations/shots are shown separately. These are not averages of individual battle rates.

Unbekannte Felder, leere Listen und Null.en: Unknown fields, empty lists and nulls are fully preserved. Unverified meanings are marked.

{deleted} Originaldateien gelöscht ({:.1.en: {deleted} original files deleted ({:.1} MB). All data remains archived. {} files retained due to errors.{}

★ markiert einen Favoriten. Ein Klick au.en: ★ marks a favorite. Click a tank name to open its battles. Click column headings to sort.

Das Gefechtsdatum im Replay entscheidet..en: The battle date in the replay is used. Subfolders are included; links, temp.wotreplay and replay_last_battle.wotreplay are excluded.

Die Originaldateien werden endgültig gel.en: Original files are permanently deleted, but all data remains in the archive. Since the battle stream is already compressed, archiving saves little total storage.

Daten werden vollständig bewahrt. Archiv.en: All data is preserved. Archiving does not automatically save total storage space.

Aufgaben und Boni sind bereits im Brutto.en: Missions and bonuses are already included in gross income. Deductions cover automatic repair and resupply recorded in the replay. Later manual purchases and inventory stock are not a complete account balance.

Boni können eine abweichende Zahl bekann.en: Bonuses may have a different number of known battles. Mission credits are reported together; daily tasks and other missions are not separated here.

Dieser Bereich enthält den unveränderten.en: This section contains the unchanged binary remainder of the replay, including format and compression data. Positions, camera, chat and events are not yet fully decoded. All bytes are preserved; individual packet contents cannot yet be fully explained.

Food = Verpflegung für die Besatzung; Me.en: Food supplies the crew; first aid kits heal crew members; repair kits repair modules in battle. Vehicle repair is the separate post-battle repair. autoEquipCost does not provide costs per individual item.

Schaden: Summen je Gefecht und Gegenfahr.en: Damage totals per battle and opposing vehicle. Ammunition type and incoming penetration/explosion counts are not available and remain NULL. Explosion hits alone do not identify HE ammunition.

Sprengwirkungstreffer sind separat in de.en: Explosion hits are shown separately in battle details. Missing values and rates without a denominator remain –. Multiple hits may produce ratios above 100%.
